decision.observation: The shutter has closed again after repeated handle clicks, while the next entrant is still approaching and the desk remains clear.
decision.hypothesis: A single click on the beige handle will reopen the shutter; pausing afterward should prevent another reversal during animation.
decision.memory: Do not repeatedly click the shutter handle during animation. Only Arstotzkan citizens with unexpired passports may enter; after stamping, return the passport directly and confirm it disappears.
